baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three ح ل ل occurrences at words 2, 9, and 12 frame the two ط ع م occurrences at words 5 and 11 as reciprocal permissions.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated release from prohibition combines with the mirrored food constructions to create controlled two-way permeability between communities: what crosses the table boundary in one direction may cross it in the other.

activation_trace.role: Release of a prohibition supplies the legal opening that makes exchange possible.
Tasting and taking food supplies the concrete substance that crosses the boundary in both directions.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists foods that are lawful to eat.
changed_reading.after: The ayah opens a regulated, reciprocal table in which lawful exchange itself alters the social boundary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ح ص ن forms at words 14, 17, and 27 are joined to payment of ء ج ر at word 26 and contrasted with س ف ح and hidden خ د ن at words 29 and 32.
baseline_models.mechanism: Marriage is modeled as a maintained enclosure established by acknowledged obligation. Giving the due supports the enclosure, while uncontracted spilling and secret erotic companionship bypass its boundary.

activation_trace.role: Protection inside a surrounding fort supplies the spatial mechanism for guarded persons and guarding spouses.
Compensation due for an undertaking supplies the openly acknowledged obligation that sustains the union.
Intercourse without a contract supplies the direct counter-form to guarded union.
Erotic companionship supplies the concealed relational channel excluded by the public enclosure.

changed_reading.before: The ayah permits marriage provided a payment is made and illicit sex is avoided.
changed_reading.after: The ayah distinguishes a publicly maintained, obligation-bearing enclosure from relations that leak around or secretly bypass that enclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ط ي ب plural at word 4 introduces an ayah whose two large domains are food and marriage.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch that pairs eating and marriage as the two pleasant goods is enacted by the ayah's own sequence: edible good is followed by guarded sexual-social good. The common heading therefore links appetite in both domains to lawful form.

activation_trace.role: The paired image of eating and marriage supplies a compact architecture for the ayah's two halves.
Actual tasting realizes the first member of the pair.
Marriage established by contract or inviolability realizes the second member in guarded form.

changed_reading.before: Good things is a general label for permissible food.
changed_reading.after: Good things headings a paired discipline of appetite: the table and marriage are parallel sites where desire receives a lawful form.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same ء ت ي root marks communities who were given the Book at words 7 and 20 and the addressees giving women their dues at word 25.
baseline_models.mechanism: The grammar turns reception into obligation: inherited gift appears first, then active giving. The Book and the marriage due are not identical objects, but their shared transfer root makes ethical reciprocity the motion connecting them.

activation_trace.role: Giving and being given supply the directional reversal from received endowment to discharged obligation.
The written object supplies what one community has received and carries.
The due compensation supplies the concrete gift that the addressee must actively render.

changed_reading.before: People of the Book identifies an external group, and dowry is a separate marriage condition.
changed_reading.after: The ayah places received revelation and rendered marital dues in one transfer circuit: having been given does not cancel the duty to give.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing sequence joins ك ف ر at word 34, ء م ن at word 35, ح ب ط at word 37, ع م ل at word 38, and خ س ر at word 43.
baseline_models.mechanism: Concealing or refusing the trusted truth removes the efficacy of intentional action, and the resulting deficit is rendered as commercial loss. The permissive social openings therefore remain nested inside a noncommercial but exacting valuation of fidelity.

activation_trace.role: Blocking the truth supplies the act that breaks the value circuit.
Heart-settling assent supplies both the communal descriptor and the trust being refused.
Falling and sinking supply the loss of operative force in the work.
Purposeful action supplies what is exposed to cancellation.
Trading loss supplies the final accounting image for failed action.

changed_reading.before: A doctrinal warning is appended after the food and marriage rules.
changed_reading.after: The closing ledger governs the whole ayah: widened lawful contact has value only inside fidelity, and action can still lose all yield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah begins with ي و م at word 1 immediately followed by the first of three ح ل ل forms.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded present is coupled to the loosening of a knot and the lifting of prohibition. The opening is therefore eventive: a previously closed relation enters a newly actionable phase.

activation_trace.role: A delimited day supplies the temporal edge of the change.
Untying supplies the transition from a bound condition to an open one.

changed_reading.before: Today merely dates the ruling.
changed_reading.after: Today marks a hinge at which bound social channels are actively untied and become usable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening of food and marriage boundaries is strengthened as accountable permeability: the nearby demand for complete performance of binding agreements supplies the load-bearing frame for the later reciprocal permissions.

activation_trace.role: Lifted prohibition supplies the opened channels being framed.
Completion without deficiency supplies the demanded quality of performance around the opening.
A firmly concluded covenant supplies the binding form within which permeability remains trustworthy.

structural_cues: 5:1 places fulfillment of contracts immediately before its first use of the same ح ل ل root later repeated in 5:5.
5:5 applies reciprocal permission to both table exchange and contracted marriage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contract fulfillment before legal opening; I infer that binding performance governs the opening rather than merely preceding it, while adjacency without functional dependence remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Reciprocal permission relaxes a communal boundary.
changed_reading.after: Reciprocal permission relaxes the boundary by means of fulfilled obligations, so openness and binding are mutually supporting rather than opposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated alternation between release and inviolability makes the focus ayah a gate-setting operation, not a declaration that boundaries have disappeared. The same social field can be opened in one respect and protected in another.

activation_trace.role: The focus repetitions supply precise releases from prohibition.
Permission and its restricted use in one ayah supply an early open-and-close gate pattern.
Inviolability, protected claim, and right supply the boundary that permission must continue to honor.

structural_cues: 5:1-3 repeatedly interleave lawful release with ritual, temporal, spatial, and edible restrictions.
5:5 itself opens food and marriage while retaining guardedness, dues, and exclusions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternating ح ل ل and ح ر م states; I infer a selectively permeable boundary, with the live alternative that the alternation is only a list of unrelated rulings.

changed_reading.before: The ayah removes the boundary between the two communities for food and marriage.
changed_reading.after: The ayah installs gates in a continuing boundary: specified goods and unions may pass, while inviolability and accountable form remain active.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding food ruling makes lawful good a product of disciplined mediation: trained agents distinguish, capture, and hold rather than merely encounter an intrinsically acceptable object. This sharpens the focus ayah's table and marriage goods as practices of handling.

activation_trace.role: Good as clean, sound, and acceptable supplies the quality requiring practical recognition.
Taking food supplies the act whose acceptability depends on mediation.
Knowledge made manifest through repeated training supplies disciplined discrimination.
Holding and retaining supplies controlled transfer rather than uncontrolled appetite.

structural_cues: 5:4 repeats the formula of what is made lawful and names good things immediately before 5:5.
Training and holding intervene between prey and eating in 5:4.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trained capture and retained prey; I infer that goodness in 5:5 includes fit handling and transmission, while the alternative is that training applies only to the special hunting case.

changed_reading.before: Good things are a preclassified set of acceptable objects.
changed_reading.after: Good things are also outcomes of disciplined handling: appetite becomes lawful through knowledge, restraint, and controlled transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same good-quality root describes earth used when water is unavailable, while purification is explicitly the intended effect. Good therefore activates as fitness to mediate a clean transition, not merely pleasant content.

activation_trace.role: Removal of filth supplies a latent purificatory range inside the focus label.
Good earth supplies a context instance where fitness belongs to a medium of transition.
A substance that purifies another supplies the directional effect assigned to the medium.
Deliberate earth-wiping for prayer supplies substitution without loss of purifying function.

structural_cues: 5:6 follows directly after 5:5 and reuses ط ي ب for the substitute earth.
The washing sequence culminates in an explicit purpose of purification rather than hardship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies good earth functioning in purification; I infer that 5:5's good things can be read as fit mediators of clean contact, while the materially live alternative limits the adjective's shared range to ordinary acceptability.

changed_reading.before: The focus good things are pleasant or permitted consumables.
changed_reading.after: The focus good things can also be fit media through which contact is made clean, extending the table-and-marriage pair into a discipline of purified relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reciprocal openings are governed by justice across antipathy. Hostility is explicitly denied authority to bend conduct, so lawful exchange with another community is not sentimental fusion but a test of stable measure.

activation_trace.role: Two-way food taking supplies the concrete cross-group relation requiring stable measure.
Hatred and enmity supply the pressure that could distort the opened relation.
Justice in judgment and conduct supplies the rule that resists distortion.

structural_cues: 5:2 and 5:8 both prohibit hostility from producing transgression or injustice.
5:5 places reciprocal food and marriage permissions between those repeated warnings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal contact plus repeated commands not to let hatred distort conduct; I infer that the permissions operationalize cross-boundary justice, while independent topical adjacency remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The ayah grants neutral permissions involving another community.
changed_reading.after: The ayah makes table and marriage openings concrete exercises in justice that must remain correctly measured even under communal antipathy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next positive ledger balances the focus warning: promise, purposeful work, forgiveness, and great compensation stand opposite covered faith, collapsed work, and loss. The marriage due participates in this larger vocabulary of value without becoming a purchase price.

activation_trace.role: Falling away supplies the negative fate of action.
Commercial loss supplies the negative total.
A spoken promise opening hope supplies the positive horizon.
Purposeful action supplies the same valued object that can either bear fruit or collapse.
Compensation for action supplies the positive counterpart to loss and echoes the marriage due.

structural_cues: 5:9 immediately follows the focus ayah with faith, work, forgiveness, and compensation.
The focus uses the same ء ج ر root inside marriage and ends with failed work and loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored work-and-value vocabularies; I infer a deliberate positive and negative ledger, while the alternative treats marital due and eschatological reward as unrelated senses sharing a root.

changed_reading.before: The final warning threatens loss after a set of permissions.
changed_reading.after: The focus and 5:9 form a balanced value ledger: obligations are rendered, works seek yield, and faith determines whether action receives compensation or collapses into loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context prevents those given the Book from functioning as a static credential. What is received can be bound by covenant, then unbound, neglected, or hidden; possession and faithful carriage are separable states.

activation_trace.role: Being given supplies reception without by itself guaranteeing subsequent fidelity.
The written object supplies the entrusted content carried by the group label.
A confirmed covenant supplies the mode by which reception becomes accountable fidelity.
Undoing what was firmly bound supplies the mechanism by which entrusted form is dismantled.
Leaving and neglecting supplies a second failure mode distinct from never receiving.
Concealment supplies a third way carried content can fail to remain available.

structural_cues: 5:12-15 narrates covenant, breach, forgetting, and concealment before naming the Book again.
5:5 describes the communities by reception, not by an assertion that every act of reception remains intact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reception plus several later failures of carriage; I infer that the focus label marks entrusted history rather than guaranteed present fidelity, while a live alternative reads it only as a conventional social designation.

changed_reading.before: Those given the Book is a stable identity category sufficient to ground the permissions.
changed_reading.after: Those given the Book names recipients of an accountable trust; reciprocal dealings remain possible even though reception, faithful carriage, and concealment must not be conflated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The written object becomes luminous and route-producing in the later sequence. The focus permissions can therefore be carried as concrete passages along guided ways of peace, rather than as an isolated accommodation.

activation_trace.role: The written Book supplies the object whose function is activated by the later movement imagery.
Illumination supplies visibility that lets a carried text disclose a traversable relation.
Gentle direction toward a road and truth supplies the Book's active guidance function.
An extended traveled way supplies the plurality of practical passages generated by guidance.

structural_cues: 5:15 couples light with a clarifying Book.
5:16 turns that light-Book complex into guidance along ways of peace.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Book, light, guidance, and traveled ways; I infer that 5:5's table and marriage permissions are among the practical passages of guided peace, while the alternative leaves the later route imagery at a general spiritual level.

changed_reading.before: Book identifies the community whose food and women enter the ruling.
changed_reading.after: Book also names an active guidance medium, and the reciprocal permissions become possible traveled ways through a historically divided social field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gift and inscription do not equal realized possession. The later land is given and written for a people, yet it must still be entered; turning back converts endowment into loss. This revises being given the Book into a vocation requiring enactment.

activation_trace.role: Received and rendered gifts supply the focus transfer circuit.
An exceptional communal endowment supplies a context case in which gift precedes demanded action.
An inscription that establishes a binding allotment supplies authorization without completed uptake.
Entry into an interior supplies the action needed to realize what has been given and written.
General deficit supplies the consequence when authorized entry is refused.

structural_cues: 5:20-21 joins extraordinary giving, divine inscription, commanded entry, and threatened loss.
5:5 similarly joins being given, permission, active giving, and a closing loss warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel gift-inscription-action-loss sequences; I infer that receiving the Book entails enacted uptake, while the alternative treats the land narrative as a separate historical example without direct pressure on the focus label.

changed_reading.before: Being given the Book is a completed possession that identifies a group.
changed_reading.after: Being given the Book is an authorized but unfinished vocation: like written land, the gift must be entered and enacted or it can terminate in loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's opened day is sharpened by the later refused doorway and forty-year prohibition. Permission is a temporal opportunity requiring entry; an opened gate can be wasted and replaced by a prolonged closed condition.

activation_trace.role: The bounded day supplies an actionable window rather than an indefinite abstraction.
Untying supplies the opening of that window.
Repeated entry supplies the demanded response to an available opening.
A doorway supplies the concrete threshold whose availability does not force passage.
Prohibition supplies the prolonged closed state that follows refused entry.

structural_cues: 5:21-24 repeats enter and not enter around the single doorway.
5:26 replaces the refused opening with a measured forty-year prohibition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded opening, a doorway, refusal, and timed prohibition; I infer an opportunity-to-entry arrow, while the alternative reads focus today as declarative dating unrelated to the later narrative.

changed_reading.before: Today announces that the permissions now exist.
changed_reading.after: Today opens a gate that calls for enacted passage; permission can be inhabited, or its opportunity can be refused and harden into exclusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fort image inside guarded marriage becomes morally ambivalent under the land narrative: an interior may protect, but it may also be occupied by coercive power. Guarded union is thus active boundary governance whose validity depends on covenantal entry rather than sheer enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Protection inside a surrounding fort supplies the focus enclosure.
Coercive domination supplies a counter-image of an interior controlled by force.
Contested entry supplies the question of how one crosses into a guarded interior.
The doorway supplies a governed passage that differs from breaching or secretly bypassing a wall.

structural_cues: 5:22-23 contrasts coercive occupants with instructed entry through a door.
5:5 contrasts guarded union with spilling and secret companionship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fortification, coercive occupants, and door-entry; I infer that the focus enclosure must be judged by its governed passage and obligations, while the alternative keeps military space and marital guardedness in separate domains.

changed_reading.before: Guardedness is simply a positive state of sexual closure.
changed_reading.after: Guardedness is a governed interior: it protects only when entry, obligation, and agency are ordered, since enclosure by itself can also host coercion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a horticultural branch distant from ordinary food language. It remains anchored in the doubled ط ع م of the focus and visibly explains cross-community acceptance; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, not a lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two ط ع م nouns face one another across the reciprocal لكم and لهم construction.

activation_trace.role: A graft accepting a branch from another tree supplies a material model for reciprocal incorporation without erasing distinct origins.
Contractual inviolability supplies the maintained structure that keeps incorporation from becoming formless merger.

changed_reading.before: Each community may consume the other's food and form marriages across the boundary.
changed_reading.after: The permissions test whether distinct social stocks can accept lawful grafts, producing shared life while the covenantal structure holds.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the closing work warning through an animal-digestion image. It remains tightly anchored in ح ب ط and the ayah's food opening; downstream prose should present it as an internal material echo, not as the primary sense of failed work.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: An ayah dominated by food ends with ح ب ط, whose inventory includes belly swelling from harmful grazing.

activation_trace.role: Eating supplies the intake domain against which failed assimilation becomes legible.
Belly swelling from unwholesome grazing supplies a deceptive enlargement that destroys rather than nourishes.
Purposeful work supplies what appears to accumulate yet can fail to become sustaining yield.

changed_reading.before: Faithlessness causes deeds to be invalidated.
changed_reading.after: The ayah's food field makes invalidated work resemble harmful intake: apparent accumulation can swell while losing all power to nourish.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation comes from the non-dominant ح ل ي mapping and is therefore form-distant and unsuitable as a controlling gloss. It remains valid as a packet-supplied split-root activation repeated at the ayah's three ح ل ل anchors; downstream prose should explicitly call it an ornamental overtone.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The three ح ل ل tokens govern the declaration, reciprocal food, and reciprocal marriage field.

activation_trace.role: Adornment worn on the person supplies an exploratory overtone of lawful relation becoming a visible social good.
Willingness and uncoerced ease supply the inward condition that keeps visible adornment from becoming mere display.

changed_reading.before: Lawfulness only removes a prohibition.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory overtone, the released table and union can become an adornment of social life: a visible good whose beauty depends on willing, uncoerced participation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the fracture-setting branch of ء ج ر rather than ordinary compensation. It remains anchored at the explicit marital due and the surrounding fortification language; downstream prose should retain it as a structural analogy and not redefine the due as therapy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ء ج ر due at word 26 sits inside the repeated ح ص ن construction and before the spilling contrast.

activation_trace.role: Bracing a crooked fracture supplies a material image for an obligation that stabilizes a vulnerable join.
The surrounding fort supplies the structure whose joined boundary requires support.
Uncontained pouring supplies the failure mode when the join has no stabilizing form.

changed_reading.before: The marriage payment is a price-like prerequisite.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, rendering the due braces a newly joined relation, helping its guarded form bear strain rather than spill apart.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain hydraulic model is unusual, but it is anchored in the focus contrast between guardedness and pouring and in the nearby covenantal rivers. It should be rendered as a mechanism of containment versus directed flow, not as a claim that the river passage directly discusses sexuality.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus opposes repeated ح ص ن guarding to س ف ح pouring while placing appetite in both food and marriage domains.

activation_trace.role: Pouring out liquid supplies desire released without a sustaining channel.
A surrounding fort supplies containment, but not yet the positive movement within it.
Continuous flowing supplies movement that remains productive rather than merely being stopped.
A river cutting a course through earth supplies the channel that gives flow durable direction.

changed_reading.before: The sexual contrast is restraint versus indulgence.
changed_reading.after: The contrast can be modeled as channeling versus spilling: covenant does not erase desire but gives its movement a durable, life-bearing course.

strongest_changes: Reciprocal table and marriage permissions became selectively permeable gates held by fulfilled obligations rather than boundary erasure.
Being given the Book became an unfinished trust whose reception must be carried, disclosed, entered, and enacted.
The opening word today became an actionable temporal window, sharpened by the later refused doorway and timed prohibition.
The closing faith-work warning became one side of a balanced value ledger completed by promise, work, and compensation in 5:9.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah repeatedly turns crossing into governed transfer: food crosses both ways, inherited gift turns into active giving, marriage admits through due-bearing enclosure, and work either carries value forward or collapses. Context adds contracts, trained holding, purification, justice under hostility, covenant breach, illuminated paths, and the refused door. The most unusual live images were graft acceptance, metabolic failure, ornamental release, fracture bracing, and desire as channelled flow.
remaining_uncertainties: The graft, brace, hydraulic, and ornamental readings are materially coherent but remain branch-distant analogies rather than controlling lexical senses.
The link between later land-entry refusal and the focus's Book-gift may be a deliberate shared mechanism or only a strong pericope-level analogy.
Good as a purifying relational medium may overextend the immediate ritual use of good earth in 5:6.
The fort image can illuminate guarded union without implying that every form of enclosure is protective or that the military narrative directly defines marriage.
